paragraphs: Ammi. “Rabbi Ammi Minni”; Ammi bar Natan in Ammi, Yirmeyah, and Zerika’s time, Hashole'ach. I do not understand: did he take Ammi Minni as a byname, and bar Natan as another man? Siftei Yeshenim likewise lists Ammi Minni. They erred; below I quote the Gemara.
